summary: Frontend-only verification of new Edit & Delete actions in Jurnal Akuntansi tab (Kas Operasional). All acceptance criteria PASS: Aksi column present, TxModal opens with correct title & pre-filled fields, running balance re-computes after edit/delete without reload, confirm dialog text is exact 'Apakah Anda yakin ingin menghapus data ini?', Cancel path preserves the tx, StatCards (stat-out-month) update live, edit for type=in shows 'Pemasukan Kas' title, and auto-tx (Kasbon Pelunasan) delete is properly blocked with a toast referencing the source module.

issues: Toast message says 'Transaksi otomatis dari Unknown KASBON-<uuid>' — the source_type resolves to literal string 'Unknown' for kasbon-originated auto transactions. Cosmetic; the block behavior itself works. Consider mapping to 'Kasbon' in orphan-check response for better UX.

action_items: Optional cosmetic: backend /cashbook/transactions/{id}/orphan-check should return source_type='Kasbon' (not 'Unknown') when the source is a kasbon settlement, so the block toast reads 'Transaksi otomatis dari Kasbon KASBON-xxx' instead of 'Unknown KASBON-xxx'.
critical_code_review_comments: CashBook.jsx is 1057 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold recommended for splitting. Consider extracting JournalTab, KasbonTab, TxModal, SettingModal, AccountsModal into separate files under src/pages/cashbook/.

JournalTab recomputes running balance from filtered list only; if user searches, running balance in the visible rows reflects only filtered set (may confuse users). Consider computing balance on the unfiltered set then filter for display, or add a note.
TxModal filters accounts by initial.type so a user cannot flip in↔out during edit — this is intentional per problem statement, good.
seed_data_creation: Created & cleaned up: TEST_JURNAL Bensin (25000→edited 40000→deleted), TEST_JURNAL Cancel (10000, cancel-flow then deleted), TEST_JURNAL Modal (Pemasukan 101, 100000→edited desc→deleted), TEST_JURNAL Kasbon (15000, settled then deleted). Note: existing TEST_UI_Ridwan kasbon from prior iteration is still present in DB (not created by this run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Journal Edit/Delete UI verified working end-to-end. Confirm dialog uses window.confirm with exact text 'Apakah Anda yakin ingin menghapus data ini?'. Always register page.on('dialog') BEFORE clicking journal-del-* buttons. data-testid pattern: journal-edit-{txId} / journal-del-{txId}. Auto-tx delete blocked via /cashbook/transactions/{id}/orphan-check (source not orphan → toast + no-op). TxModal reused from BookTab; filters accounts by initial.type (no flip in/out allowed on edit).

Create pengeluaran 105 BBM 25000 → visible in DEBET column
Edit → TxModal title 'Pengeluaran Kas', fields pre-filled with old data
Edit 25000→40000 & desc revised → toast 'Transaksi diperbarui', row updates live, Total Debet footer +15.000 (Rp 140.500 → Rp 155.500)
Cancel dialog text matches exactly: 'Apakah Anda yakin ingin menghapus data ini?'
Dialog Cancel → tx remains in table
